name: sickslip-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for SickSlip, the online doctor's note service (sickslip.co). Lets Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client verify a SickSlip note, list the US states where SickSlip can issue a note, quote current pricing, pick the right note type (work, school, Amazon DLS, travel), and check the physician's NPI.
author: SickSlip, Inc. <support@sickslip.co>
